mapper.select: SELECT * FROM HDOC_VARIABLES WHERE VARIABLE = #{variable} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HDOC_VARIABLES (VARIABLE, TYPE, DESCRIPTION, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS) VALUES (#{variable}, #{type}, #{description}, #{registerDatetime}, #{registerUser}, #{registerProcess}, #{updateDatetime}, #{updateUser}, #{updateProcess})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HDOC_VARIABLES WHERE VARIABLE = #{variable}
